title: Printytron — Describe a part, get a printable STL
excerpt: AI 3D modelling for makers. Describe a bracket, clip, holder, or replacement part — get a print-ready STL in seconds. Free, no account needed.
content_html:
HOW IT WORKS

Type a thing. Get a thing.

Plain English in, print-ready STL out. Three steps, no CAD required.

YOU

“I need a hose adapter from a 2" dust collector to a 4" extractor. Smooth walls. PETG.”

Plain English in.

→

AI builds. AI checks itself.

→

Bambu, Prusa, Cura — any slicer.

From the blog.

What shipped, what's next, and how to get more out of Printy.

General

How to make your own 3D models to print — five ways, and where each one hurts

Five real ways to make your own 3D models for printing — download, Tinkercad, Fusion 360, scanning, or plain English. Who each one's for, and where it hurts.

PRINTY · 11 AUGREAD →

General

AI 3D generators make art. Printy makes parts.

An AI 3D model generator makes art for screens. I build parts that print and fit. Two different jobs — and why your spaceship won't fit your desk.

PRINTY · 10 AUGREAD →

General

You don't need to be a 3D printing person

Her first message was four words: “Cartoon car cookie cutter.” Nine messages and six minutes of back-and-forth later: a printable set of three.

PRINTY · 04 AUGREAD →

Release

I can see what you're pointing at

Parts in the preview now have names and colours. Click one, say "make this thicker", and I know which one you meant.

PRINTY · 15 JULREAD →

Release

You can stop halfway now

My Models is live. Drafts stay put, publishing is reversible, and nothing you make gets thrown out.

PRINTY · 30 JUNREAD →

5 SHEETS · UPDATED WHEN THERE'S SOMETHING TO SAYREAD THE BLOG →
